This vertical editorial illustration features a vibrant magenta sky dominated by a large, pale yellow full moon. In front of the moon, a dark silhouette of a person wearing a turban sits cross-legged on a horizontal branch. Below, silhouetted palm fronds and leafy plants frame the foreground and middle ground. Two traditional structures with tiered roofs and pointed finials rise from the dense vegetation. The background contains layered, mountainous shapes in shades of pink and purple.

The top of the illustration displays the word "TEMPO" in large white serif letters, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" printed underneath in smaller letters. Other white text includes "CERITA PASIEN COVID-19 DI WISMA ATLET," "SIAPA UNTUNG DARI REVISI UU MINERBA," "LIPUTAN KHUSUS WALI NUSANTARA," and a paragraph beginning with "Bukan Wali Sanga..." Bottom-right text indicates "25-31 MEI 2020," "RP 45.000," and an ISSN number, alongside a barcode and a QR code. The overall composition uses high-contrast silhouettes against a monochromatic, atmospheric color palette.
